notes.title: Rebellion! Save fixes
notes.content:
Greetings!

After a break, we would like to announce Rebellion has been updated to version 1.1.0.  The main focus of this update is to improve the reliability of our saving system.  Unfortunately, the old saves will be deleted, but saving will now be more reliable, and also, the game will save after quitting (cowardace).

We hope you are enjoying our game!

AiryTheDragon
DaDarkWizard

notes.title: Rebellion! Game and Soundtrack now released!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The Rebellion! Game and Soundtrack are now released!

Now you can enter the world of Rebellion, and write your way to freedom!

You are a writer, however in the interest of public safety, the local manager has banned pens and paper.  All things mightier than the sword are banned!

Guards have been released to keep everyone "safe" in front of their TVs!

Can you build the support you need to end the restrictions and free the people?

Welcome to the Rebellion!

Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard

For those curious, a short explanation on the slow progress:
  I (DaDarkWizard) am an active undergraduate nearing degree completion! I will be pursuing a
  Doctorate in Computer Science, and these are the final couple weeks of the semester. Research and
